name: hermes-kanban-live-gantt
description: Live Gantt for the Hermes kanban boards — a now-centered, slidable 72 h timeline (default now -24 h -> now +48 h) with hour-granularity wheel zoom and an optional done lane. Fork of kanban-gantt (GPL-3.0).
author: ningfangbin (fork of kanban-gantt by e-is)
